The Best of Tavares
Capitol Records ST-11701 (1977)

A classic soul/disco greatest hits collection from Tavares featuring fan favorites including "Heaven Must Be Missing an Angel," "It Only Takes a Minute," "Don't Take Away the Music," and more.

Condition

Vinyl: VG

  • Nice glossy playing surface.
  • Light cosmetic sleeve marks from normal use.
  • No deep scratches observed.
  • Should provide an enjoyable listening experience.

Jacket: G

  • Moderate shelf wear and edge wear.
  • Ring wear and scuffing on front and back.
  • Small hole punch/cutout in upper right corner.
  • Tape residue and old tape along the top edge.
  • Corner and edge wear as shown in photos.

Please review all photos carefully as they are part of the description.

Track Highlights

  • Heaven Must Be Missing an Angel
  • It Only Takes a Minute
  • Bein' With You
  • Don't Take Away the Music
  • Check It Out
  • Remember What I Told You to Forget
  • She's Gone
  • The Love I Never Had

Record Grading

  • Record: VG+
  • Sleeve: G+/VG-
